encounters.title: The Besieged Outpost
encounters.description: Smoke rises from a crumbling outpost on the edge of contested space. Sensors show League wreckage scattered around the perimeter — and a single heat signature inside. One cat, holding the line alone against impossible odds.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Sensors are picking up League wreckage scattered around that outpost. Somebody put up one hell of a fight down there.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Single heat signature inside. Still alive. Still armed, from the look of the energy readings.

choices.text: Land and approach the outpost on foot.

outcome.description: The outpost walls are scorched black. Inside, a scarred cat with no tail crouches behind a barricade, weapon trained on you.

choices.text: Hail the outpost from your ship — identify yourself as Corsair.

outcome.description: Static. Then a rough voice answers the hail.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Stop right there. Hands where I can see them, or the next thing you see is the inside of a body bag.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Easy. I'm not League. Felid Corsair — Captain Aristotle. We picked up the fighting on sensors.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Corsair. Great. Last Corsair who came through here promised reinforcements. That was three weeks ago. I'm still waiting.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Looks like you managed on your own. That's a lot of League wreckage for one cat.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Twelve scouts. Two gunships. They thought one outpost with one defender wasn't worth a proper assault force. They were wrong.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: I can see that. You're No Tail, aren't you? I've heard stories.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Stories don't hold positions. Ammunition does. Speaking of which — mine's getting low. So either say something useful or move along.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Corsair, huh? Lot of Corsairs ran when the League showed up. You here to fight or to talk?

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Depends on what needs fighting. I'm Captain Aristotle. We saw the wreckage on approach — impressive work.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Don't flatter me. Flattery is what people do when they want something. What do you want?

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Honestly? I saw one heat signature holding off what looked like a League squadron's worth of debris. I wanted to see who was still standing.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Well, now you've seen. I'm No Tail. This is my outpost. Or what's left of it.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: You want to keep talking, come down here and talk face to face. I don't trust anyone I can't see.

encounters.title: Proving Ground
encounters.description: No Tail crosses her arms. League scouts are regrouping at the edge of the outpost. This is a test — not just of skill, but of whether Aristotle will stand and fight.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Sensors are lighting up. More League scouts, coming in from the dust belt. They're regrouping for another push.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: How many?

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Enough. Words are cheap, Captain. I've watched a hundred talkers run at the first sign of League cruisers.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: So here's the deal. Help me finish this. Fight beside me, right here, right now. Then we'll talk.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: And if I say I'd rather handle this from the ship?

choices.text: Fight alongside No Tail against the League scouts.

outcome.description: The battle is short and brutal. No Tail fights like a cornered animal — all fury and precision.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Good answer. Take the left flank. Don't get in my line of fire. And Captain?

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Yeah?

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Try to keep up.

encounters.title: No Tail Joins the Crew
encounters.description: The League wreckage smoulders around the outpost. No Tail sits on the wall, cleaning her weapon with practised hands. For the first time, her expression isn't hostile — just tired.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: You didn't run.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Was that a compliment?

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: It's an observation. Most Corsairs I've met talk big and fly fast in the wrong direction. You stayed.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: You needed a hand. It wasn't complicated.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: No. It wasn't. That's what I liked about it.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: My outpost is gone. My crew — what was left of them — evacuated weeks ago. I stayed because someone had to hold the line. But the line's moved now.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: What will you do?

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: My guns still work. My aim hasn't slipped. And I've got nowhere else to be.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: So. Need a gunner, Captain?

choices.text: The guns are yours. Welcome aboard, No Tail.

outcome.description: No Tail's scarred face cracks into something that might be a smile. She slings her weapon over her shoulder and follows you to the ship without looking back.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Right then. Show me the weapons systems.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Deck two, forward battery. Four pulse cannons, two torpedo tubes. They could use someone who knows how to—

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: I'll figure it out. I always do.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: One rule, Captain. When I say 'fire,' you don't second-guess me. In combat, hesitation kills.

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Fair enough. One rule from me — we don't shoot first unless we have to.

dialogue_steps.speaker: no_tail
dialogue_steps.text: Fine. But when we do shoot, we shoot to end it. Point me at the enemy. I'll handle the rest.
